description: A painted interior of a stone church or hall, lit by candles. A seated figure in white and gold vestments sits on a raised throne at right, with a bishop's crosier nearby. Rows of mitred bishops sit on wooden benches on both sides, and a robed scribe writes at a lectern in the foreground over an inlaid marble floor. No visible text, frame or graphic content. The era looks medieval or early modern.
